independentLayers.description: The data-* state contract (Base UI names): field state and per-control state maps that both renderers set (React through components/state.react.ts).
Value snapping, key and pointer mapping and slider ARIA; for a pair, ordering, thumbs that stop at each other, the nearer thumb for a press and per-thumb ARIA.
Reference numbers for track, thumb and fill (a pair's fill: trackPairFill).

intent: Set a number within a bounded range by position
Set a sub-range (start and end) with two thumbs when the value is a pair

properties.description: Form field name; the host submits its value under this name. Reflected because the form reads the attribute.
Blocks interaction and submission. An ancestor <fieldset disabled> has the same effect without setting this property (isDisabled).
Inherited; a range always has a value.

inspector.reason: A range always has a value.

properties.description: Live value: a number, or a pair [start, end] for two thumbs (attribute "20,80"; the pair is snapped and ordered). The value attribute at connect is the reset default.

Base UI defaultValue: the value at first render (when no value attribute or property set it) and after form reset. Without it, the value attribute is the default, like a native input's. A pair ("20,80") is the default of a two-thumb range.
Accessible name (aria-label); not visible. A pair names the group, and its thumbs "<label>, minimum" and "<label>, maximum".
Human text for each thumb's value (aria-valuetext): {value} stands for the thumb's value, e.g. "{value}%" or "{value} °C"; text without {value} is used as written.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

events.name: input
events.detail: { value: number | [number, number], activeThumbIndex?: 0 | 1, reason: 'keyboard' | 'track-press' | 'drag', event: Event }
events.trigger: every value change from keys, a track press or a drag (Base UI onValueChange)

events.name: change
events.detail: { value: number | [number, number], reason: 'keyboard' | 'track-press' | 'drag', event: Event }
events.trigger: an interaction ends with a new value: each key step, or pointer release after a press or drag (Base UI onValueCommitted)

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Runs validation; fires invalid when it fails.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Marks the field touched (errors show) and reports.

methods.name: setCustomValidity
methods.description: Sets an author error; an empty string clears it.

keyboard.action: step up / down (Left/Right flip in RTL)

constraints: template() owns track, fill and thumb; the ratio reaches CSS as --ui-ratio (0…1). Contains no native form elements; form participation goes through ElementInternals (UIFormElement).
input fires while dragging or stepping; change fires on key commit and pointer release.
The value attribute at connect is the reset default. Values snap to step.
label sets aria-label; value-text sets each thumb's aria-valuetext ({value} stands for the thumb's value).

Composition: track › indicator and thumb may be authored as [data-part] spans; the host adopts their attributes and classes (the thumb also its content) onto the generated parts. React: Slider.Root (alias Range.Root) with Slider.Track › Slider.Indicator and Slider.Thumb, which renders the painted thumb and the native range input after it (Base UI's Thumb also holds the input: the input takes keys, pointer and the form value, so it is not a separate part); every React part takes render (an element or (props, state) => element) and className (a string or (state) => string); the recipe class and data-* stay on whatever renders.

A pair value renders two thumbs: the host is role=group (named by label) and is not focusable; each thumb is role=slider and a tab stop, with data-index. A thumb stops at the other (they may meet, never cross); a track press moves the nearer thumb. With a name, the form value is one entry per thumb. React: one Slider.Thumb per value (index 0 and 1); the thumb inputs ignore the pointer and the root maps it.

avoidWhen.when: The exact number matters more than its position.
avoidWhen.reason: Dragging to an exact value is slow; an input is faster.

avoidWhen.when: Showing progress the user does not set.

intent: Show how much of a task is done
Show that work is ongoing when no value is set

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

constraints: No value (or NaN) means indeterminate: data-indeterminate and a sweep; reduced motion shows a faint full fill.
value is clamped to 0…max; the ratio reaches CSS as --ui-ratio.

Composition: track › indicator may be authored as [data-part] spans; the host adopts their attributes and classes onto the generated parts. React: Progress.Root with Progress.Track › Progress.Indicator; the Root renders the native <progress> after its parts; every React part takes render (an element or (props, state) => element) and className (a string or (state) => string); the recipe class and data-* stay on whatever renders.

avoidWhen.when: A button is waiting on its own action.
avoidWhen.reason: Button loading shows busy in place.

nodes.summary: The thumb, inside the track like a switch thumb (track − u, inset 0.5u); offset 0.5u + ratio × (width − track). The fill wraps it with a concentric cap.
